asset.title: Prism Breaks — Movement I
asset.summary: calm, minimal, nocturnal, cinematic, lofi section

rights.note: Verify the active ElevenLabs paid-plan music terms before commercial publication.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental only. First movement of a continuous 10-minute futuristic broken-beat focus session at 104 BPM. Preserve the elegant sonic world of the original Prism Breaks study: a syncopated kick-and-rim pattern with a light two-step feel, clipped hand percussion, a rubbery but restrained sub-bass motif, airy synthetic mallet plucks, and an expansive cool pad. Shape a calm long-form arc rather than a loop: 0:00–0:25 a soft signal arrives; 0:25–2:30 a clean, stable broken groove; 2:30–4:25 a subtle bass and mallet variation; 4:25–5:24 a slightly wider luminous harmonic color. Keep each change sparse and patient, with enough low-frequency articulation for a contained visual response. In the final six seconds, gently thin upper percussion and leave bass and pad breathing for a seamless handoff. No vocals, no lo-fi, no Rhodes, no acoustic piano, no vinyl dust, no jazzy chords, no trap hats, no dramatic build-up, no drop, no heavy wobble bass, no harsh treble, no EDM risers, and no abrupt ending.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental only. A hypnotic 42-second minimal electronic focus track at 116 BPM with a steady, elegant motorik pulse. Use a soft but firm four-on-the-floor kick, a sparse dry clap or rim, one quietly ticking percussion line, a dark analog sequence, a rounded bass anchor, and wide translucent synth chords. Keep it sleek, spacious, and slightly futuristic: stronger rhythmic propulsion than lo-fi, but never clubby or aggressive. Structure: 0–6 seconds ignition, 6–29 seconds steady propulsion, 29–35 seconds color opening with a second sequence layer, 35–42 seconds reduce back to the core pulse. asset.title: Prism Pulse
asset.summary: minimal, dark, energetic, lofi short track

rights.note: Verify the active ElevenLabs paid-plan music terms before commercial publication.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental only. A polished 42-second nocturnal minimal electronica focus track at 108 BPM. Build a clear, tactile groove from a compact punchy kick, a short muted rim hit, syncopated tom-like percussion, an elastic mono-synth bass pulse, glassy analog chord stabs, and a thin granular shimmer. The rhythm should be confident and forward-moving but leave large pockets of silence; it should feel like colored light orbiting a dark energy core. Structure: 0–7 seconds sparse signal, 7–28 seconds locked groove, 28–35 seconds a subtle harmonic lift, 35–42 seconds a clean restrained release. No vocals, no lo-fi, no Rhodes, no acoustic piano, no vinyl crackle, no jazz harmony, no EDM riser, no big drop, no aggressive sidechain pump, no festival snare, no harsh highs.
